text: Yes, the 2022 tree-cover loss of about 0.6 ha (3.41% of the asset) was corroborated by the independent reference (JRC GFC2020). The evidence shows that the loss area was confirmed as forest in 2020 (JRC agreement fraction = 1.0) and was observed in a later year (2025). However, the cause, legality, or responsibility for the loss cannot be determined from this data. The loss was within the native forest context of the 17.6 ha rural property.
